key.name: shortcuts-enabled
key.description: Whether QuickTiler registers its keybindings with Mutter. Turning this off releases every one of them, so the accelerators go back to whatever else claims them. The quick settings menu keeps working, because the pause is about the keyboard and nothing else.

key.name: show-quick-settings
key.description: Add a QuickTiler tile to the system menu, listing every action with the shortcut it currently holds. Turning this off builds no actor at all, which is what lets the extension go back to costing nothing between keypresses.

key.name: gap
key.description: Pixels between neighboring tiled windows and between a tiled window and the edge of the work area.

key.name: tile-left
key.description: Cycle the focused window through the left zones.

key.name: tile-right
key.description: Cycle the focused window through the right zones.

key.name: tile-center
key.description: Cycle the focused window through the center zones: half, top third, then bottom two thirds.

key.name: tile-maximize
key.description: Fill the work area, or restore if already filling it.

key.name: focus-left
key.description: Move focus to the nearest window to the left.

key.name: focus-right
key.description: Move focus to the nearest window to the right.

key.name: swap-left
key.description: Exchange the focused window with its left neighbor.

key.name: swap-right
key.description: Exchange the focused window with its right neighbor.

key.name: move-monitor-next
key.description: Move the focused window to the next monitor, keeping its zone.

key.name: move-monitor-prev
key.description: Move the focused window to the previous monitor, keeping its zone.
